purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0042 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出导致 response time 下降的原因。
front.task_prompt: Because 后面是原因；dropped by 20 percent 是结果，不要把方向倒过来。

task_schema.focus: Because 引出的原因与 dropped 引出的结果
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把 weekly practice sessions 判断为原因，把 response time dropped 判断为结果

options.text: The support team received weekly practice sessions.
Average response time dropped by nearly 20 percent.
The support team hired more employees.

audio.transcript: Because the support team received weekly practice sessions, average response time dropped by nearly 20 percent.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。因果逻辑题先看连接词给出的方向：Because 后面不是结果，而是导致结果的原因。这里 weekly practice sessions 解释了为什么 response time dropped。B 是结果本身，C 和 D 都没有文本依据。做类似题时，先把句子改写成“因为 A，所以 B”，再去选项里找 A 或 B。
tips: Because 后面通常是原因，不是结论。
看到 dropped / rose 这类变化词，要问“是什么导致变化”。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 because 引出的原因与结果方向

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户在 CET4 听力因果推断中先定方向，避免把结果当成原因。

front.text: 听完后，选出 deadline reminders 带来的直接结果。
front.task_prompt: After 引出措施，后半句给出直接观察到的变化；不要把措施本身或延伸推断当答案。

task_schema.action: 四选一：措施与结果匹配
task_schema.success_criteria: 能选出措施后文本直接报告的变化，不做跳跃推断

options.text: Students became more interested in all courses.

audio.transcript: After the deadline reminders were introduced, the share of late submissions fell from 22 percent to 11 percent in one month.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 C。这里的因果不是“所有学习态度变好”，而是很窄的措施-结果关系：引入 deadline reminders 后，late submissions 的比例下降。A 把范围扩大到所有课程兴趣，B 改成教师降低难度，D 无中生有。因果推断题要守住文本给出的直接结果，不能把合理联想当答案。
tips: After...introduced 常提示“措施出现后发生的变化”。
比例下降时，优先选直接变化，不要选更大的背景推论。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 匹配措施后的直接因果结果

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 帮助用户在数据变化类听力中选择文本直接支持的因果结果，避免跳跃推断。

front.text: 听完后，选出 as a result 后面的结果。
front.task_prompt: suppliers delayed shipment 是原因；as a result 后面才是导致出的结果。

task_schema.action: 四选一：因果触发词后的结果识别
task_schema.focus: as a result 后的结果边界
task_schema.success_criteria: 能把 delayed shipment 与 production targets not met 的因果关系分开

options.text: Several suppliers delayed shipment this month.
Production targets were not met on schedule.
Shipment delays were solved ahead of time.

audio.transcript: Several suppliers delayed shipment this month; as a result, production targets were not met on schedule.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。as a result 是很明确的结果触发词，后面通常跟“所以发生了什么”。这里 suppliers delayed shipment 是原因，production targets were not met on schedule 才是结果。A 是原因，不是结果；C 没有说；D 与未按时完成相反。遇到 as a result，要把触发词前后切开，后半句优先当结果。
tips: as a result 后面通常是结果。
不要把触发词前的背景原因误选成结果。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 as a result 后的结果并排除原因项
